subject: GreenGrid promo top-up + invoice netting request
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@greengrid.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:14:00 -0500
Subject: Promo credit balance + invoice offset request

Hi Vivek and Laura,

Hope you’re both well. We ran into a timing mismatch on our pilot spend — per the attached statement we still have an unused promotional balance of $18,750 on our account (deal GG-2026-351). Our CFO would prefer that Redwood issue a credit memo we can apply to our upcoming December invoice rather than a standalone voucher. Separately we’d like to confirm a 30-day trial extension for the core ingestion pipeline while we finalize an internal integration test (no additional cost).

Questions: can Redwood 1) create a proforma credit memo we can sign, 2) post the credit to offset INV-2026-1142, and 3) route the accounting so our ERP shows the offset against December AR? If there’s a tax or GL implication, please flag it.

Attaching the promo statement for reference. Happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Jenkins
VP Finance
GreenGrid Analytics
accounts@greengrid.com

Attachment: GreenGrid_Promo_Statement_2026-11.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@greengrid.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Promo credit balance + invoice offset request

Sara — thanks for the clear note and the statement. Looping in Finance (Laura) and Accounting (Marcus) + Sales Ops (Neha) to align on the mechanics. Quick plan proposal from my side:

- We’ll prepare a proforma credit memo for $18,750 and share it for signature.
- Once signed, Redwood Finance will post a credit memo referencing INV-2026-1142 and apply it to the December invoice as requested.
- For accounting: recommend mapping the credit to the promotion allowance GLA (suggested code: 6400-PRM) which posts as a contra-revenue item; if Finance prefers a different treatment we’ll follow their guidance.
- We can grant the 30-day extension at no charge once the signed proforma is on file.

Laura/Marcus — are you ok with contra-revenue mapping and the posting flow above? Marcus, it would help to confirm the journal entry we should create so we can tell the customer what they’ll see in their ERP.

Sara — I’ll get the draft proforma attached by end of day today.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Americas
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proforma_credit_memo_GG-351.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Promo credit balance + invoice offset request

All — thanks for the context. Finance confirms we can issue a customer credit memo for $18,750 to offset invoice INV-2026-1142. A few notes and required items before we post:

1) Please confirm the exact invoice number(s) to apply the credit to (Sara confirmed INV-2026-1142 in the thread, but we need final written confirmation).
2) Accounting treatment: we will post the credit to GL account 6400-PROMO (contra-revenue). That approach has been our standard for promotional allowances and aligns with our month-end close.
3) Tax: credit memos will reduce taxable revenue for the period; Marcus, please confirm if we need to create any tax adjustment records for the State jurisdiction.
4) Required doc: signed proforma credit memo (we prefer PDF). Once we have that, Finance will: create the credit memo in billing, apply it to the invoice, and produce the journal entry.

Marcus — please prepare the following journal entry after the credit is applied:
- Debit 6400-PROMO $18,750
- Credit 4000-AR $18,750

Neha — after you confirm the acceptance and attachment from GreenGrid, please upload the signed copy to the Drive folder below and mark this deal in HubSpot as credit-applied.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1A2b_gg-351-credit-docs
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4321/GG-2026-351

I’ll queue this for posting on Tue end-of-day once we have the sign-off.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Promo credit balance + invoice offset request

Laura — got it. I’ll handle the journal entry posting once Finance confirms the signed proforma is uploaded. One minor accounting ask: can we include the original revenue recognition period in the memo (for audit trace)? For example: "Original Rev Period: Oct 2026". If GreenGrid requires a voucher instead of a credit memo we’ll need to take a different approach, but their note asked explicitly for a credit memo so that should be fine.

Planned journal lines to be posted after application:
- Dr 6400-PROMO $18,750
- Cr 4000-AR $18,750

If tax adjustments are needed I’ll create a separate tax entry.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Accountant
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@greengrid.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@greengrid.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:35:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Promo credit balance + invoice offset request

Vivek/Laura/Marcus — confirming: INV-2026-1142 is correct and we authorize Redwood to apply a $18,750 credit to our December invoice. Deal ID GG-2026-351. We also accept the 30-day extension on the ingestion pipeline.

I’ve attached a signed acceptance for the proforma — please route it to Finance and confirm when the credit is applied.

Regards,
Sara Jenkins
VP Finance
GreenGrid Analytics

Attachment: signed_acceptance_GG-351.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@greengrid.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Promo credit balance + invoice offset request

Thanks Sara — received and uploaded.

Status update:
- Signed proforma received and stored: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1A2b_gg-351-credit-docs
- Laura/Marcus will post the credit memo and journal entry today EOD and apply it to INV-2026-1142.
- 30-day extension has been granted (ends 2026-12-30).
- HubSpot updated (deal GG-2026-351) with credit-applied tag and documents.

If anything changes I’ll follow up, otherwise you should see the applied credit reflected on your December AR export.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Americas
Redwood Inference
